title: How Australia Lost a War to 20,000 Emus 😭 #Shorts
description:
In 1932, Australia sent soldiers with machine guns into a war against birds — and lost.

When 20,000 emus stormed Western Australian wheat farms, Major Meredith deployed two Lewis machine guns and 10,000 rounds. Between jammed guns, 50 km/h sprints across rough outback terrain, and flocks posting tall lookouts, the emus walked away undefeated — and still sit on Australia's coat of arms today.

title: What Would Actually Kill You First on Mars? 🚀 #Shorts
description:
Mars looks like a freezing red desert — until the air pressure drops below 1% of Earth's and the water on your tongue starts to boil at body temperature.

Here is the exact physical countdown of what kills you first on Mars — from 6 millibars of thin air, to -125°C polar winters, toxic perchlorate soil, unshielded cosmic radiation, and a 22-minute wait for Earth to hear your distress call.

Every measurement is verified against NASA, JPL, and ESA mission data.
